$comment: Upstream sources the frontend brain depends on. Read by scripts/brain-watch.mjs and the brain-update skill. type: rss (RSS or Atom feed), github-releases (repo, optional match = tag regex, prereleases), github-commits (repo, optional path, pinned = vendored commit), npm (package, versions with publish time). affects: files or folders in plugins/frontend-pack that a change upstream can make stale. Every URL and repo was checked to respond on 2026-10-25.

sources.name: Next.js Blog
sources.note: Major releases, security advisories, new rendering and caching APIs.

sources.name: Next.js releases
sources.note: Stable tags only; canaries are skipped. Security patches need a knowledge entry or a version floor.

sources.name: React Blog
sources.note: Official React release notes and deprecations (react.dev/feed.xml serves the same feed).

sources.name: @tanstack/react-query
sources.note: npm instead of GitHub releases: TanStack/query publishes ~20 packages per release, react-query gets buried.

sources.name: @tanstack/react-router
sources.note: Patch releases are frequent; act on minor and major versions and on breaking notes.

sources.name: Vercel React Best Practices (agent-skills)
sources.note: Vendored as is in react-brain at the pinned commit. New commits mean a re-vendor: copy files unchanged, bump the pin in react-brain/SKILL.md and NOTICE.md.

sources.name: Vercel Web Interface Guidelines
sources.note: Adapted, not vendored: port new guidelines by hand.

sources.name: shadcn/ui changelog
sources.note: Monthly changelog posts: base library, CLI, new components.

sources.name: shadcn CLI releases
sources.note: Only the shadcn CLI package; @shadcn/registry and helpers are skipped.

sources.name: Vite releases
sources.note: Core vite tags only (create-vite and plugin tags are skipped). Backport tags of old majors show up too.

sources.name: MSW releases
sources.note: v3 option names differ from v2; check typings on every minor.

sources.name: Zod releases
sources.note: Schema API used for every API response and form.

sources.name: React Hook Form releases
sources.note: v8 betas exist (October 2026); they are skipped until v8 is stable.

sources.name: Figma Code Connect releases
sources.note: Machine-readable Code Connect changelog. The Figma REST API changelog page has no feed (404 at the old URL), so it is not watched.

sources.name: Figma MCP server guide
sources.note: Figma's official guide and skills for the MCP server; the closest machine-readable changelog of the MCP tools.
